official.deadline_central_display: November 1, 2026 (Early Decision I / Early Action, Fall 2027 entry)
official.deadline_note: Financial aid (CSS Profile) deadline for EDI/EA is November 15; final credentials are due November 13 (EDI) or November 20 (EA), and incomplete files roll into Regular Decision.
official.application_cycle: Fall 2027 first-year entry (Early Decision I or Early Action)
official.status_note: The published Stamps timeline for the current first-year cycle: apply EDI or EA by November 1, semi-finalist interviews by mid-January, finalist notification at Early Action release in late January, Stamps Foundation interview, recipients announced in early March.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Stamps Scholars receive the full cost of attendance for eight semesters (10 semesters for students in five-year degree programs) or the completion of the first degree, whichever is sooner. The Stamps Scholarship includes tuition and fees, on-campus housing, a meal plan, University health insurance, textbooks, a laptop allowance, and access to a $12,000 enrichment fund.
official.funding_period: full cost of attendance, up to eight semesters
benefits: Access to a $12,000 enrichment fund (study abroad, undergraduate research, unpaid internships, and other educational pursuits, subject to prior approval)
eligibility: Incoming first-year students who apply and are admitted through either the Early Decision I or Early Action admission plans
Exceptional students whose academic achievement, leadership, and curiosity position them to make the most of a University of Miami education
No separate scholarship application outside of the Common Application
Selected through the University of Miami's holistic review process
requirements: Complete a full-time undergraduate program of study with no fewer than 12 credit hours during each of the fall and spring semesters (minimum 24 credit hours per academic year)
Maintain a minimum 3.0 GPA at the University of Miami, with the initial calculation at the end of the second semester of attendance
Enrichment fund expenses are subject to prior approval
The award is subject to revision pending receipt of any grant, scholarship, or prepaid tuition and/or housing aid not anticipated at the time the award is made
documents: Personal statement of 650 words or less (University of Miami does not require a supplemental essay)
One letter of recommendation/evaluation from a school counselor or teacher
Official secondary school transcripts, with certified English translation if applicable
Standardized test scores per UM testing policy (self-reportable; official reports required if admitted and enrolling)
Official TOEFL, IELTS, or Duolingo English Test results for students whose native language is not English
selection_criteria: Holistic review through the University of Miami admission process
Semi-finalists contacted and selected to interview with the Stamps Scholarship Committee by mid-January
Finalists notified of their status at Early Action decision release in late January, then interview with the Stamps Foundation
coverage: Up to $12,000 enrichment fund for approved educational pursuits
application_method: Automatic consideration via the University of Miami Common Application under Early Decision I or Early Action; there is no separate scholarship application
official.application_route: Submit the Common Application by November 1 under Early Decision I or Early Action; Stamps consideration is automatic.
official.international_eligibility: International applicants follow the same EDI/EA route; students whose native language is not English must submit official TOEFL, IELTS, or Duolingo English Test results
official.duration: Eight semesters (10 semesters for students in five-year degree programs) or completion of the first degree, whichever is sooner
official.description: The Stamps Scholarship is UM's most prestigious merit award, recognizing exceptional students whose academic achievement, leadership, and curiosity position them to make the most of a University of Miami education; Stamps Scholars receive the full cost of attendance and take part in exclusive programs, one-on-one advising, and group community service with support from the Office of Academic Enhancement.
official.english_requirement: All students whose native language is not English are required to submit official TOEFL, IELTS, or Duolingo English Test results (per UM first-year admission requirements).

verification.notes: UM publishes the award as full cost of attendance with a $12,000 enrichment fund but no single dollar figure; the Fall 2027 EDI/EA November 1 deadline was confirmed on the admission plans and deadlines page.

applicant_utility.summary: Stamps is considered automatically with your Common Application, but only if you apply Early Decision I or Early Action by November 1 - applying Regular Decision effectively removes you from contention. The award equals full cost of attendance (tuition, fees, housing, meal plan, insurance, textbooks, laptop) plus a $12,000 enrichment fund for study abroad, research, or unpaid internships. Prepare for an interview track: semi-finalists are chosen by mid-January, finalists are notified at EA release, and recipients are announced in early March.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Exceptional first-year applicants with strong academics and leadership who can commit to UM early and want costs fully covered without a separate scholarship application.
application_readiness_checklist: File the Common Application under Early Decision I or Early Action by November 1
Submit the CSS Profile by the November 15 financial aid deadline
Have official TOEFL/IELTS/DET scores sent if English is not your native language
Prepare for a possible mid-January interview with the Stamps Scholarship Committee and a later Stamps Foundation interview
Plan enrichment-fund uses in advance, since expenses require prior approval
common_rejection_risks: Applying Regular Decision or after November 1 - only EDI/EA applicants are considered
Falling below 12 credit hours per semester or a 3.0 GPA, first measured at the end of the second semester
Treating the enrichment fund as unrestricted spending money when uses require prior approval
Incomplete files by the final credentials deadline (November 13 EDI / November 20 EA), which rolls the application into Regular Decision
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Anything outside the published full-cost package - personal travel home and discretionary spending beyond the approved uses of the $12,000 enrichment fund.
document_audit: No separate scholarship application exists, so a missed Common App deadline means no consideration at all
Non-native English speakers need official TOEFL/IELTS/DET scores sent directly from the testing agency
One counselor or teacher recommendation letter is required through the Common Application
alerts: Early Decision I is binding - Stamps consideration requires committing to UM if admitted under EDI
The award is subject to revision if other grants or prepaid tuition/housing aid arrive later
The Frost School of Music Stamps Ensemble Scholarship is a different award - do not confuse the two
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Common App by November 1 (EDI/EA) -> automatic Stamps consideration -> semi-finalist interviews by mid-January -> finalist notification at EA release -> Stamps Foundation interview -> recipients announced early March.
